errors.text_span: Cardio is represented in orange, Gastro in tan, Infect in orange, Neuro in orange, Obstetrics in orange, and Pediatrics in orange.
errors.evidence: The description misidentifies the colors representing each specialty. Cardio is a very light tan, Gastro is light orange, Infect is orange, Neuro is brown, Obstetrics is darker brown, and Pediatrics is dark brown.

errors.text_span: The shortest bar in the chart, at approximately -27, is the baseline model fine-tuned on Cardio data; the tallest bar, at about -22, is the model fine-tuned on Obstetrics data.
errors.evidence: The shortest bar corresponds to the baseline model, not fine-tuned on Cardio data. The tallest bar in each group is the baseline model.
The description does not mention that the chart illustrates negative log probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between the baseline and fine-tuned models.
